oracle: NCAR TUV-x v0.17.0 (ebec1cb4) with a clean-room musica_assert, host-column harness over tools/tuvx_oracle/photolysis.json (TUV 5.4 cut to O2, O3 -> O(1D), O3 -> O(3P) and NO2); x86-64 glibc host, gfortran -O2 -ffp-contract=off (tools/tuvx_oracle/build.sh)

units.configuration: the wavelength grid's edges (nm) and the extraterrestrial flux on its bins (photon cm-2 s-1), as the built core holds them
units.intermediates: first two cases of each layout, five height edges (0-based): cross sections cm2, quantum yields, actinic flux parts per bin; radiative_transfer: spherical geometry (nid per edge and dsdh rows of the kept edges, both counted from the top), air and O2 vertical (per layer) and slant (per edge) columns molecule cm-2, the O2 reaction's cross section with the Lyman-alpha / Schumann-Runge bands applied, and per kept layer (0-based from the surface) each radiator's optical depth and the accumulated optical depth, single-scattering albedo and asymmetry factor
